name: Silver Haze
summary: Silver Haze is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] bred by [[breeder:Sensi Seeds]], combining [[haze|Haze]] with a [[northern-lights-5|Northern Lights]]-line parent to shorten its flowering time and height for indoor growing. SeedFinder names that parent as [[silver-pearl|Silver Pearl]], itself a cross of [[early-skunk|Early Skunk]] and Northern Lights #5. Its release year is not documented.

sources.title: Cannabis Strain Focus: Silver Haze
sources.note: Planner-verified 2026-09-24: confirms Haze combined with a Northern Lights-line parent to shorten flowering time and height for indoor growing. Does not itself name Silver Pearl; that specific parent name comes from SeedFinder.

sources.title: Silver Haze (Sensi Seeds)
sources.note: Names the parent cross as Silver Pearl x Haze.
